subject.title: fix(qqbot): bound gateway websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should QQBot adopt an unconditional 30-second opening-handshake cutoff for all existing accounts and proxy setups?
rationale: The patch correctly prevents permanent connecting state, but choosing the hard cutoff determines whether very slow existing handshakes fail and reconnect after upgrade.

options.title: Approve the 30-second bound
options.body: Accept the sibling-aligned fixed timeout, rebase with the payload-cap PR if needed, and merge after confirming the combined factory diff.

options.title: Choose another fixed bound
options.body: Select an owner-approved constant and require the same stalled-peer proof plus a representative slow proxy-handshake check.

options.title: Wait for live QQ evidence
options.body: Pause until a credentialed QQBot connection through a representative proxy confirms normal opening comfortably completes within the cutoff.

recommendation.title: Approve the 30-second bound
recommendation.body: Accept the sibling-aligned fixed timeout, rebase with the payload-cap PR if needed, and merge after confirming the combined factory diff.

likelyOwner.reason: Their major refactor owns the current QQBot gateway connection lifecycle and makes them the strongest available reviewer for its timeout behavior.
